description: Public small stencil preview: renders the registered stencil's compact SVG (the same text-trimming pipeline the toolbox tiles use) for hosts that present stencils outside the toolbox — the Modeling "Open in editor" notation palette and the preview legend embed it instead of duplicating the icon markup. Always aria-hidden: the visible text label of the surrounding row/tile owns the accessible name. A stencil id the registry does not know renders the generic fallback shape.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: CSS size of the icon box (applied to width and height). Default "32px" — the toolbox tile size.

parameters.name: StencilId
parameters.description: Stencil id to preview. Null or unknown ids render the fallback shape.
